title: Birth and the family house on Broadway
summary: Steinau was born in New Orleans in 1927 and lived in the same house at 2325 Broadway until age 24.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in Hotel Dew in New Orleans on February 25th, 1927.

And grew up in New Orleans, lived in the same house from the time I was six months old until I was 24 with some hiatuses for being in the service, but basically the same house. You go up to college, you said you were in college.
But what was that house? Hmm? What was the address of the house?

It's, you know, it's near, it's about three quarters of a block off the intersection of Broadway and South Claiborne. Mobile is the, is the next street over. I always like Mobile because it's only been two, it was, it was two blocks long and I'm not even sure it still exists.
